subject: English
stimulus: (a) He pretends as if ⎯⎯. (b) It is high time for us ⎯⎯. (c) Walk slowly lest ⎯⎯. (d) If your answer is correct ⎯⎯. (e) Had he been a little careful ⎯⎯.
guide_solution: Completing sentences (a) If you want to be a good student, you should attend classes regularly and study diligently. (b) Follow me lest you should miss the train. (c) Feel free to borrow my book provided that you return it in time. (d) People who live in glass houses should not throw stones to others. (e) He was so craven that he could not muster the courage to face the situation.
source: SSC English 2nd-paper Cumilla Zilla School, Cumilla (Test Paper School 2nd) 2023
